title: Save is blocked for a margin of 100 and a % Off over 99.99
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, Default on Margin % 30, tier A on % Off 10.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 100 in Default's first range.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Type 30 in Default's first range.
  7. Type 120 in tier A's first range.
  8. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The cell reads 100.

Step 5:

  • The save is refused, the cell is highlighted and the message includes "Enter a margin from 0 to 99.99".
  • The 100 is not changed into another value.

Step 6:

  • The cell reads 30.

Step 7:

  • The tier A cell reads 120.

Step 8:

  • The save is refused, the cell is highlighted and the message reads "Enter a % from 0 to 99.99".
